title: A Letter Along the Road

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a letter

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: You've walked so many roads this fortnight! Would you like to write to someone at the end of one of them?

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Mrs. Hannah would love a letter. The drovers will carry it down the farm road.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the letter: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I walked the road to the {place}.
This summer I walked the road to {place}.
I will walk to your farm {when}.

feedback.all_good: A fine letter. Mrs. Hannah will read it at her kitchen table!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Off it goes with the drovers. Letters are like roads, you know: they join friends who are far apart.

journal_line: I wrote a letter to Mrs. Hannah about the roads I walked.
